title: Validation, Migration and Import/Export
objective: Define structural/behavioral/integration validators, playable/incomplete/invalid/migration-required states, version migration and historical-choice preservation.
acceptance: missing canon is never silently fabricated
boundaries: MVPS-12 owns species-facing structural/behavioral/integration validation, migration and import/export contracts only; generic migration/versioning/import-export infrastructure remains with shared owners.
Missing, source-unspecified or conflicted canon must remain explicit and may never be silently fabricated during validation or migration.

Historical CharacterSpeciesSelection receipts, exact species/version references, lineage/form selections, adjudications and provenance must survive deprecation/replacement unless an explicit migration receipt records the governed change.
Migration-required state must be distinguishable from playable, incomplete and invalid states, with explicit discrepancy/recovery evidence.
Import/export preserves stable identity, exact-version references, provenance, unresolved/conflict state and owner-domain references rather than flattening shared mechanics into species-local data.
Runtime active-contribution projection/receipts remain MVPS-13; MVPS-13+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: Run the MVPS-12 regression on the exact causal-RED head; it must fail because the five MVPS-12 contract artifacts are absent. Then implement only the bounded species validation/migration/import-export contracts.

last_material_progress.evidence: Lane-state revision 2 / progress_seq 1; implementation branch created from AIOC main 5f716e245c6cfdf065a5bf53374f594ac6315a59.
